extracted.name: Sauteed Carrots and Leeks
extracted.description: Leeks and carrots are simmered in a buttery broth for a quick and easy side dish the whole family will enjoy.
instruction_lines: Combine leeks, carrots, chicken broth, butter, sugar, thyme, salt, and pepper in a skillet; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until liquid evaporates, about 15 minutes. Cook and stir mixture until leeks and carrots are lightly browned, 2 to 3 minutes.
